title: Clone multiple equipment cards from template
goal: Use template.content.cloneNode(true) to reuse a copy of non-rendered HTML.
summary: equipment card is the same, but the title and number are different. Clone a card for each piece of data after pressing the button.
tasks: When clicking #build, first clear #cards, and then clone the complete content of #card-template for each record according to devices.
is added to the list after filling in .model and .code. Repeated clicks will not generate duplicate cards.

example.note: template is first stored in the fragment and is not displayed directly. Deep cloning copies nested child nodes.

hint: cloneNode(true) again in each round, and then fill in the current record into the cloned fragment.
